senses.definition: מִיָּמִן assigned to David’s time, 1 Ch 24:9.
Neh.’s time Ne 10:8 = מִנְיָמִין 12:17, 41.
מִנְיָמִן assigned to Hezekiah’s time 2 Ch 31:15.
מִיָּמִין went up with Zerub. Ne 12:5.
one of those who took strange wives Ezr 10:25.—𝔊 Βενιαμειν and (especially A 𝔊L) Μιαμειν.
